name: Copilot Environment Preparation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at midnight UTC to keep the environment cache fresh
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  prepare-environment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Cache environment for Copilot
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            node_modules
            dist
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-copilot-env-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-copilot-env-
